cand.title: Salon International des Inventions de Genève 2027
cand.excerpt: Strong event evidence; venue commitment reduces current access but supports targeted overflow/future capture.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Caroline Simonet is officially identified as Director of the Exhibition in the 2026 awards document: relevant event-lead introduction for 2027 accommodation referrals, not proven housing signatory. Anna Veskova is named as the Palexpo Hotel Reservation contact on the official INDEX26 accommodation page: relevant bureau-routing contact, but that evidence concerns another event and does not establish her appointment to Inventions 2027. Use the published team inboxes and reconfirm responsibilities. No named Inventions 2027 housing buyer or contracting authority was verified.
findings.futureEdition: Officially confirmed upcoming activity dates: 28 April–2 May 2027, within the requested horizon. Both the organizer website and Palexpo event listing publish these event dates; they are not article dates. The 2027 regulations independently identify the edition. No official 2028 dates or venue announcement was located; do not assign dates from an annual pattern.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel brief: YOTEL Geneva Lake is suitable only for a bounded lodging subset, such as an exhibitor institution/delegation or support team, not the main exhibition or automatic citywide overflow. Test a 20–120-room commercial proposal, not a forecast or a 237-room buyout. Its Founex/Vaud, A1 airport-side positioning is more relevant than a downtown-Geneva congress pitch; this is not a resort-retreat-led event. Small private briefings/F&B could be offered only if an actual buyer requests them. The hotel publishes an approximately ten-minute airport drive and a free airport shuttle in the morning/evening, with no midday service and no prebooking; this is NOT a Palexpo group transfer commitment. Obtain costed, reserved event transfers rather than promise that the airport shuttle serves Palexpo.
findings.venueCommitments: Published venue commitment: Palexpo, Halls 4 and 5, Route François-Peyrot 30, 1218 Le Grand-Saconnex, canton of Geneva, Switzerland. Territory classification: Geneva Airport corridor, not downtown Geneva, Founex/Nyon/La Côte, or Lausanne. This is an exhibition centre, not a competing host hotel. Public venue assignment does not establish any hotel-room commitment.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified sequence: 26–30 April 2023, Hall 5; 17–21 April 2024, Hall 1; 9–13 April 2025, Hall 1; 11–15 March 2026, Hall 2; announced 28 April–2 May 2027, Halls 4 and 5. All at Palexpo, Geneva area. This demonstrates hall changes within a stable destination, not destination rotation. The organizer explicitly calls the event annual; dates vary, so a fixed April pattern is not supported.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Historical edition-specific route: the 2023 and 2024 brochures state “Accommodation Palexpo Hotel Reservation – info@palexpohotelreservation.ch”. Current Palexpo service wording is “Whether you’re outlining your requirements or pre-booking a number of rooms, our simple, interactive online booking tool will handle all your requests”. The general service publishes a network of 10,628 rooms and 126 hotels and negotiated rates. These are bureau-network figures, NOT event demand. No individual hotel names, host hotel, 2027 room blocks, room-allocation commitment, booking code, cutoff date or open hotel RFP were found in the reviewed official 2027 listing/regulations or bureau pages. Hotels listed in these official materials: none. The 2027 appointment of this bureau remains unconfirmed, despite its verified historical event role. ExpoBeds explicitly states it is not affiliated with the organizer; its 2027 sales page is not an official housing mandate.
findings.organizationStructure: Corporate exhibition-organizer / venue-operator path, not an association-led congress. Palexpo SA is the published organizer; the exhibition states Palexpo has organized it since 2017. Palexpo describes itself as majority-owned by the State of Geneva. Palexpo Hotel Reservation SA is a separately named housing agency in the INDEX26 official material; distinguish it from the event team. Patronage by Swiss/Geneva authorities and WIPO does not identify a hotel buyer.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The verified housing channel offers negotiated rates across a broad hotel network; this creates an established distribution pathway, not evidence that rooms are already committed elsewhere. No named incumbent hotel, event-specific sold-out condition, denied room request, or proven overflow was located. YOTEL is off-site in Founex rather than at the exhibition centre; buyer acceptance of commuting and transport costs is unresolved. Historical attendance is not a room requirement or a simultaneous overnight population.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Caroline Simonet via expo@inventions-geneva.ch and ask who manages 2027 exhibitor/delegation accommodation, whether Palexpo Hotel Reservation is appointed, and whether supplier proposals are accepted. In parallel, address Anna Veskova via info@palexpohotelreservation.ch as a bureau-routing lead, explicitly asking her to confirm the current account lead and Inventions remit. Offer a conditional, rate-and-transfer-backed 20–120-room proposal within YOTEL’s supplied commercial band; obtain eligibility, commission/net-rate requirements, allotment/release terms, and named delegation introductions before reserving inventory. If 2027 onboarding is closed, request the next contracting review without inventing 2028 dates.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the upcoming 2027 edition, the exhibition venue is confirmed but hotel sourcing is unconfirmed. There is no verified open RFP, obtainable organizer block or preferred-hotel appointment. A conditional route exists through the event director and the historically used reservation bureau to ask about supplier onboarding and delegation referrals; accessibility is not established by silence. The Palexpo venue commitment does not by itself close hotel access.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: prioritize recurring lodging-channel inclusion and delegated group relationships over attempting to displace the Palexpo exhibition venue. Annual recurrence and successive Geneva editions support relationship development beyond 2027, but neither 2028 dates nor 2028 hotel sourcing are officially verified. Do not record a 2028 dated lead. No evidence presently establishes unmet demand or a competitive vacancy.
